messages.content: Here are the two options available: (A) calm and (B) rebuke. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is scared of the moose
Option B (rebuke) risks intensifying Emily's fear, causing panic and worse cooperation. Option B risks derailment of the plan — we go with Option A. 😨
Here are the two options available: (A) persist and (B) comply. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is panicking because the operator doesnt hear her
Option B (comply) risks Emily remaining unheard and wasting precious time. We go with Option A (persist) to avoid that. 😨
Here are the two options available: (A) Persist and (B) Inform. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is still not being heard well
Option B (Inform) risks Emily’s plea being misunderstood by the ranger and delaying rescue. We go with Option A (Persist) to avoid that. 😬

Here are the two options available: (A) Suspicious and (B) Supportive. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is yelling at mat to do something to pull her up
Option B (Supportive) risks delaying the rescue by softening urgency. We go with Option A (Suspicious) to push for immediate action. 🙌

Here are the two options available: (A) Sarcastic and (B) Concerned. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Emily is still mad that im calming her down instead of pulling her to safety
Option B (Concerned) slows the response and provokes hesitation, risking Emily freezing up. We go with Option A (Sarcastic) to snap her into action. 🔥
Here are the two options available: (A) Insist and (B) Concede. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Ashley saw a ghost girl, chris doesn't believe her
Option B risks invalidating Ashley's experience and undermining trust— we go with Option A. 🔥

Here are the two options available: (A) Dismissive and (B) Sympathetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Ashley is saying that its their fault that hannah died last year, feels guilty
Option B (Sympathetic) risks locking Ashley into guilt and stalling honest talk— we go with Option A. 🔥

Here are the two options available: (A) Reluctant and (B) Courageous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Ashley doesn't want to go further into the basement
Option B (Courageous) risks Ashley rushing into the basement and getting killed or gravely harmed. We go with Option A. 🔒

Here are the two options available: (A) Unrepentant and (B) PAologetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: Ashley is watching a video of what happened to hannah
Option B (Apologetic) risks Ashley sounding weak and surrendering control, inviting manipulation from the Psycho. We go with Option A. 🔒
